thread:
maria-ae: @tom-legal @linda-procurement attaching the redlines from Acme (order form + MSA + DPA). They need the POC infra gated behind signed docs. Can we get signoff on two asks: 1) adjust liability cap wording, 2) clarify SLA is non-binding for POC. Also customer asking to waive the one-time setup fee for the POC. cc @aj-se for infra lead time. Need to aim for signatures by Thu AM so we can provision next week.
 tom-legal: on it. Quick thoughts: liability cap — won't accept unlimited liability. Propose: "Customer's aggregate liability shall not exceed the amount paid by Customer to Redwood Inference in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim." For SLA, we can mark POC as "target only" and not eligible for credits. DPA — add subprocessors appendix. I can draft these updates now.
 aj-se: tech note: if MSA stalls we can offer a hosted sandbox for the POC (performance differs). Dedicated VPC requires signed MSA + DPA and ~5 business days to provision. Also need billing/quotas for the POC — estimate ~4 GPU-days/day. If hosted is ok, ops can spin up by tomorrow.
 linda-procurement: procurement needs signed order form + MSA before we accept PO. Standard payment terms are net30; customer asking net60. We can escalate for net45 but need finance sign-off. DocuSign is fine for signature routing.
 ron-customer: we can do net45 and will sign via DocuSign. We need setup fee removed for POC — that's a blocker for us.
 maria-ae: @tom-legal please push the exact liability language and update the DPA subprocessors. @contracts-bot any precedent for net45 template we can use? I'll collect billing signers.
 contracts-bot: template found: https://redwood.internal/contracts/templates/startup-net45 — pulling doc now.
 tom-legal: draft language below — please review and flag:
```
Liability cap: "Customer's aggregate liability shall not exceed the amount paid by Customer to Redwood Inference in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim."
POC SLA: "For POC or evaluation deployments, SLA metrics are targets only and are not eligible for service credits."
DPA: add Appendix B (Subprocessors): Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Sentry, Datadog.
```
I'll mark the one-time setup fee as waived for this POC in the order form.
 maria-ae: That liability wording is acceptable to Acme. @linda-procurement can you confirm finance ok with net45 and setup fee waiver for POC <$10k ARR?
 linda-procurement: Finance tentatively approved net45 and the setup fee waiver for POC under $10k ARR. I'll prepare the internal PO template once DocuSign completes. Need billing remittance details.
 aj-se: one more tech callout — if we do hosted POC, data will not be inside their VPC. They asked for EU residency; DPA must reflect that and include subprocessors. If they require Dedicated VPC for POC, provisioning waits until post-signature.
 ron-customer: we can accept hosted for initial eval if DPA includes EU residency guarantees and subprocessors list. We'll sign the DPA and MSA as updated. Billing contact: ops@acme.com; finance signer: Tina Miller; legal signer: Mark Lee. Net45 confirmed.
 maria-ae: Great — @tom-legal please attach the updated redline + DPA. I'll create the DocuSign envelope with two signers (legal + finance) once attachments are final.
 tom-legal: uploaded redline excerpt and updated DPA to the thread. Excerpt: "Liability cap..." and Appendix B subprocessors added. I removed the setup fee line from the order form and flagged net45 in payment terms.
 contracts-bot: DocuSign envelope created: envelopeId=env_0b9c, link=https://docusign.redwood/env/env_0b9c (signers: Mark Lee (Legal), Tina Miller (Finance)).
 maria-ae: Envelope sent via DocuSign. @ron-customer please check your inbox and forward to Tina if needed.
 ron-customer: Signed by Mark Lee, routed to Tina now.
 contracts-bot: DocuSign envelope env_0b9c completed at 1719460001. All signers completed.
 linda-procurement: Received signed order form & MSA. Uploaded PO (PO# 45231) to internal system and will email Tina the remittance confirmation. Sending invoice process to finance.
 aj-se: Infra scheduled — provisioning ticket created. Dedicated VPC will start on Mon (5 business days after signature). If they want hosted POC earlier, we can spin sandbox tomorrow.
 maria-ae: Closing the loop — thanks everyone. I'll update the CRM and mark POC as "contract-signed". :tada:
 tom-legal: noted — please file executed copies to contracts repo.
 contracts-bot: Executed docs archived: https://redwood.internal/contracts/archive/45231-msadpa
 maria-ae: Awesome. Moving to handoff with SE and CS. Thanks all! :pray:
